question: A fort had provision of food for 150 men for 85 days. After 15 days, 25 men left the fort. Find the number of days for which the remaining food will last.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Remaining food is sufficient for 150 men for (85 − 15) = 70 days.

New number of men after 25 left = 150 − 25 = 125 men.

Using M₁D₁ = M₂D₂ ⇒ 150 × 70 = 125 × x

⇒ x = 10500 ÷ 125 = 84

**∴ The correct answer is 84 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial number of men = 150

Initial duration = 85 days

Men leaving after 15 days = 25

**Formula Used:**

Total Food = Men ×
